financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Initial public offering of 2,750,000 shares of common stock at $4.00 per share, closed December 4, 2024
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: We received approximately $9,515,000 in net proceeds from our initial public offering after payment of underwriting discounts and commissions and estimated expenses of the offering.

warrants.quote: As of September 30, 2024, there were 1,359,375 warrants outstanding, 1,626,037 restricted stock units and 10,633,988 stock options
